dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Oh wow... Is it just me, or are there a lot more guests arriving to enjoy Lantern Rite than last year...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what exactly is this stall?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Hello there! This is the "Gift Envelope Consultancy" specially set up by the Ministry of Civil Affairs!

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Do you know about gift envelopes? They are a tradition here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: We make them every Lantern Rite and give them to our family and friends, sending them our best wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've seen that lots of tourists from other nations have arrived for this year's Lantern Rite, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: They're interested in gift envelopes, and they all want to give the tradition a try themselves... But understandably, they don't know the first thing about making them.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: In response, the Ministry has sent me here to set up the Consultancy... on account of my penmanship, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Whether you want to make a gift envelope to send good wishes to kith and kin, or if you'd like to leave a commemorative envelope for yourself, you can come seek me out for help.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I can even help add Guyan Sigils to your envelope, or perhaps draw some patterns onto it... In these things and more, I shall help you as far as I am able.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do many people come to you for help?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Oh, lots. So many foreign guests have come in to have envelopes written up that I've had to get a new notepad just to record all their names.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: But there are just way too many clients. Apart from those who request that I write everything for them, there are also many who ask for suggestions for their well-wishes...

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I'd love to have someone to help me out here, but I am well aware the Ministry has no spare manpower during Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you help me look at the requests that I recorded on my pad? If you could help me settle some of these commissions, that would be better still...

response.speaker: Weijin
response.text: Wonderful! Thank you for your help. Please, have a look at these commissions.

choices.text: I've got other things going on right now...

response.speaker: Weijin
response.text: That's fine. If you're willing, you can swing by later as well. I'll be here manning the counter in the meantime.
